notes: Payloads follow the field names and envelopes of the official Xstream doc samples (checked 2026-10); the docs' samples are for RELIANCE/ITC/BANKNIFTY 2024 contracts, so option rows carry dummy NIFTY/SENSEX October 2026 ScripCodes in the documented scrip-master format. The scrip-master Expiry column is shown as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (the doc types it INTEGER without a sample; the parser also accepts /Date(ms)/ and 'DD Mon YYYY'). Session fields are added per fixture so manifest.creds stays logged out for sessionLogin.test.mjs. Every token, id and name is a dummy.
